title: Intelligent Agents and Environments
overview: Model an AI system as an agent that perceives an environment through sensors and acts through actuators to maximize a performance measure.
objectives: Classify environments (observable, deterministic, episodic, static, discrete)
Compare reflex, model-based, goal-based, and utility-based agents

method.title: Percepts and actions
method.body: An agent maps its percept history to an action; the agent program implements this mapping.

method.title: Rationality
method.body: A rational agent chooses the action expected to maximize its performance measure given its knowledge and percepts.

method.title: Environment properties
method.body: Properties such as partial observability or stochasticity determine how hard the design problem is.

method.title: Agent types
method.body: Simple reflex agents use condition-action rules, while goal and utility agents reason about future outcomes.

pseudocode:
loop:
    percept = sense(environment)
    state = update_state(state, action, percept)
    action = choose(state, rules_or_goals)
    act(environment, action)
